summary: CR-069 Employee Management Module - Full E2E testing completed. All 23 test cases passed. Login with owner@18march.com works, loading page completes successfully, /employees page loads with Employee Management heading and Employees/Roles tabs. Employees tab shows 27 employees with inline editable grid (First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Password, Role, Status columns). Add Employee button creates new green-highlighted rows at top, bulk add works (multiple clicks create multiple rows), trash icon removes new rows. Search filters employees correctly. Password column shows masked dots with key icon for reset. Role dropdown populated with roles from API. Status toggle (Switch) present for each employee. Roles tab shows 19 roles with rich 6-column table (role info, employee count, permission coverage bar, last modified, status, edit action). System Roles banner shows BAR, CAPTAIN, KDS, MANAGER, OWNER, WAITER. Category color legend shows 8 business groups. Coverage percentage badges are color-coded. Template badges 'FROM: OWNER' visible. Edit button opens role form with pre-filled name and checked permissions. Role Form has 8 collapsible permission groups, per-section counters, global counter (7/52 selected), template dropdown with templates (Accountant, Billing User, Captain, etc.), back arrow navigates back. Sidebar Settings > Employee Management navigates to /employees (not Coming Soon toast).

issues: Minor: The '+ Add Employee' button text could be more prominent - currently shows as '+ Add Employee' which is correct but the green color blends with the Save All button when both are visible

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing (employee-management-page, tab-employees, tab-roles, employee-grid, employee-search, employee-add-btn, employee-save-all-btn, employee-row-{id}, emp-status-{id}, emp-reset-pwd-{id}, role-list-view, role-table, role-row-{id}, role-edit-btn-{id}, create-role-button, role-form-view, role-name-input, role-template-select, perm-section-{id}, role-form-back, role-form-save, role-form-cancel)
API integration working correctly - employees-list returns 27 employees, role-list returns 19 roles, all-role-list returns permission catalog with roleTypes, role-master-list returns templates

Permission catalog correctly defines 52 permissions in 8 business groups (Orders & Billing, Discounts & Offers, Tables & Rooms, Delivery & Online, Menu & Inventory, Customers, Setup & Admin, Reports & Analytics)
Sidebar navigation properly configured - Settings > Employee Management navigates to /employees route
Inline editable grid pattern implemented correctly with new row creation, bulk add, delete, and save all functionality
